title: Work tape head movement
statement: Let $c,C$ be natural numbers, $x$ a finite Boolean input, $q$ a natural number, and $s,s'$ control states. Given work-tape head positions $h$ and output word $o$, choose a tape index $i$ and a movement $d\in\{-1,0,1\}$. Applying the action that keeps the input head fixed, leaves all tape contents and the output unchanged, moves only head $i$ by $d$, and sets the control state to $s'$ yields the configuration with state $s'$, head positions updated by replacing $h(i)$ with $h(i)+d$, and all other data unchanged.
hypotheses_covered: Control states $s,s'$ of the specified finite control set
A head-position function $h$ from the $c+1$ work-tape indices to $\mathbb{Z}$
A movement $d$ in the sign type $\{-1,0,1\}$
